annotations.title: Danish Electricity Day-Ahead Prices (DK1, DK2, NO2, SE3, SE4)

description: Day-ahead electricity spot prices for one day and bidding area, in EUR and DKK per MWh, quarter-hourly or hourly, with min/max/average and the cheapest hours. Tomorrow's prices are normally published around 13:00 CET. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

cheapestHours.description: How many cheapest hourly slots to list.

date.description: Danish local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

resolution.description: Hourly averages or the native 15-minute prices.
